_comment: Copy to manifest.json and point it at your own clips. Paths are from the
repo root. One entry per CLIP, not per model -- every model in the run is
activity must be a key of ACTIVITIES in src/kinematics.js: pullup, dip,
pushup, squat, slsquat, cmj, sj, walk, run, heelraise, kickback, sidestep,
fps is the rate the phone FILMED at. Get it wrong and every velocity,
moment and power in the comparison is scaled wrong -- ffprobe -show_streams
will tell you. A slow-motion clip must state its real rate (120, 240),
groundTruth.offsetS is (lab clock - video clock). Leave it null and the
harness recovers it by cross-correlation and reports the r it achieved;
state it when you have a genuine sync signal (a clap, a trigger, an LED).
expect is what YOU know about the clip: how many reps are in it, and what
movement it is. It is scored against the app's own classify() and rep
detector, which is where most of the practical difference between models
